observations: The draft carries one guard earlier entries in this lineage did not need: 'g21 leftover-join and g21-fixture-corpus are different lineages; their version numbers are unrelated.' D-348 is the first entry where both lineages present the numeral 20 at once - frozen unrecorded corpus v20 alongside current recorded join v20 of G21 - and a reader who fused them would conclude the entry records a frozen predecessor as current. The sentence is doing real work here.

The staleness deferral is the structurally interesting choice.
